name: ACC Graphs Are Not Contained in Cube-Chordal Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of ACC Graphs belongs to Cube-Chordal Ample Classes.
proof: The central square and its four private leaf squares have a star join tree, but the leaf intersection graph is an induced four-cycle.
